title: Federation U03: work directly on the hub

briefDescription: Starting at C0, A commits a title edit A1, B commits an unrelated description edit B1, and H commits a separate requirement H1. A publishes first. B fetches A1, Dolt merges A1+B1 into M1, validation passes and M1 publishes. H fetches M1, merges H1 into M2 and publishes. A/B accept M2. Every original commit remains an ancestor. A publication race returns head_changed and repeats fetch/merge; no force push. This assumes nonconflicting cells and valid domain relationships. Requirements: FR-MCP-178,181,188.

title: Federation U04: simultaneous clean edits on all three systems

briefDescription: A and B both change one requirement's priority from the same base to different values and commit independently. A publishes A1. B receives A1 while holding B1; merge reports a conflict. B retains its last valid local state, and H/A retain A1. B's plugin displays base/local/incoming values and requests review. A reviewed resolution creates M1 including both histories, passes validation and publishes; H/A then accept it. Changed heads invalidate an old resolution. Delete/update and schema conflicts use the same visible review boundary. Requirements: FR-MCP-180,181,183.

title: Federation U05: conflicting edits to the same field

briefDescription: The A/B-to-hub link fails; H retains local access to its own gateway and remote. H, A and B still execute local business operations and make H1/A1/B1 commits. H may publish H1 locally while A/B record pending publication; they do not return queued-only results for local business writes. On reconnect A merges H1+A1 into M1 and publishes, then B merges M1+B1 into M2 and publishes; H/A catch up to M2. They authenticate, reconcile remote heads and process requests plus their own unpublished commits. Merge/review follows U04/U05. An empty hub queue does not strand local commits. No automatic hub failover is claimed. Requirements: FR-MCP-174,175,178,179,181,185.

title: Federation U09: lost response or crash during synchronization

briefDescription:
Both real lab stores are SQLite. The migration tool additionally supports PostgreSQL and SQL Server fixture sources. It plans those sources, inventories local-only versus shared data, detects legacy-ID collisions and checks the Dolt schema. Ph3 delivers seed and all-domain/all-branch project recovery export (including the TODO subset); Ph6 adds join only after branch/commit/publication/review exist. Exactly one seed establishes C0 per project. Other nodes clone C0 and import their frozen legacy differences on migration branches descended from C0, then merge/review them normally. Verification accounts for source rows already in C0, mapped deltas and explicitly reviewed exclusions/deletions. Include TODO/generic audit history in the independent hub backfill and verify every durable receipt. Detect same-work/different-ID duplicates for review and preserve permanent origin-scoped aliases, without rewriting historical text. A failed verification leaves the original provider active. No unrelated root histories or implicit deletion of seed rows are allowed. Requirements: FR-MCP-182,184,186,187.

Same-identity rows with different legacy contents require a recorded keep-seed/take-join/manual-value review before the join commit, even if Dolt would merge cleanly. Verify the immutable migration commit and the reviewed main result; keep destination writes closed until integration and verification finish.

title: Federation U10: migrate an existing project

briefDescription:
H's maintenance role publishes a supported schema upgrade. B advertises an older capability and records incompatible_schema; it does not apply it or claim to be current. B may continue supported local work while publication is held. After preflight and binary upgrade, B merges S1 with its retained unpublished B1 to form M1, validates and publishes M1, then H/A accept M1. Both B1 and S1 remain ancestors; B does not simply replace B1 with S1. Each feature branch catches up separately through review/validation. Nodes never independently run EF migrations on versioned project startup. Incompatible contract changes wait for subscriber acknowledgement or explicit de-enrollment/recovery. Requirements: FR-MCP-181,183,186.

Before swapping B's binary, its owners explicitly commit or resolve all drafts and the schema head must be available locally; otherwise upgrade waits without touching drafts. B attests every local branch, including unpublished ones. Maintenance preflight gates deployment. Each branch reopens only after its local worker merges the designated schema history and validation passes; a catch-up conflict blocks that branch only. The new EF model never edits an unsupported dirty working set or independently executes project migrations.

title: Federation U12: two agents on one host

briefDescription: Precondition: A is enrolled in Atlas; main=C0 and A has authorized local audit storage. A edits T1 while offline, appending immutable audit E1 and its outbox entry. On reconnect, audit/batches sends E1 through the IdentityServer gateway, independent of Dolt commits. The hub stores it append-only and returns a hash-bound receipt. A lost receipt causes retry, not duplication; the node retains E1 permanently. Postcondition: one E1 at each origin/hub ledger, main and remote still C0, local draft preserved. Errors: invalid_token, unauthorized_project, audit_id_conflict. Requirements: FR-MCP-AUDIT-001, FR-MCP-184/185/188. Ph2/Ph3/Ph5/Ph7.

title: Federation U14: duplicate work, permanent aliases and human IDs

briefDescription: Precondition: A1 was published under epoch E1/generation90 and remains on A/B, but the backup contains C0/generation40. Restore keeps ingress disabled, installs a fresh E2 and advertises only verified restored heads. A node's E1 report receives hub_epoch_changed; it retains A1. The hub requests candidate history and validates ancestry before republishing A1 under E2. Audit inventories reconcile independently and permanent node ledgers resend missing records. Postcondition: no force push or forced node rewind, all recovered history preserved, receipts refer to E2 and no missing audit row is falsely acknowledged. Requirements: FR-MCP-179/181/184/188. Ph5/Ph6/Ph8.
